content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment refers to the process of selling digital ebooks online, where buyers can purchase using cryptocurrencies directly, and the ebooks are automatically delivered to their digital wallets without relying on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. This approach gives creators full control over their digital commerce stack, eliminating platform fees and dependence on central authorities. It's a game-changer for digital creators in restricted markets who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without the hassle of traditional payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery after crypto payment involves a combination of software tools and infrastructure. At the core is NOWPayments, a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, ensuring seamless ebook delivery and order management. This architecture allows creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack.
